name: 江湖 I (Jianghu I)
english_description: A large, traditional MudOS-lineage wuxia MUD, unrelated in code lineage to the "Book and Sword" series. New characters choose one of four starting temperaments in the "Land of Peach Blossoms" starting area and can receive a substantial one-time gift of skills and equipment simply by asking a wandering envoy about the jianghu — a much faster on-ramp than formal apprenticeship. Combat is structurally safe (sparring automatically stops around half health), and disconnected players are preserved in place rather than swept into a holding room.
